title: Record Findings as You Find Them
tagline: Partial progress survives a truncation; an end-of-context array does not.

story.problem: A research specialist returned every vendor it found in one closing JSON blob, which made each finding hostage to the last token. A truncated reply, a transient provider error or a cancelled turn lost the whole category — and lost it silently, because an empty result from a specialist is indistinguishable from a market with nothing in it.
story.solution: Each vendor is written to the KV research store the moment it is verified, through a record_vendor tool that takes exactly one finding. The planner reads them back with get_research, which joins the findings to the live trace so a truncated specialist, a stalled one, an all-refused one and a genuinely empty category each produce a different instruction. The subagent's outputSchema was deleted outright: a structured return on a long-running child escalates a formatting miss to OUTPUT_SCHEMA_NOT_FULFILLED and kills the session, and it guarantees nothing the durable store does not already hold.
story.outcome: Partial progress survives an interruption and 'recorded 0' became a detectable failure the planner can act on, re-running only the specialist that was cut off. Deleting the schema alone scored 33/37 on npm run eval:scout; the run that measured 3-4 vendors per specialist with zero truncations scored 52/53 and carried a later guardrail fix as well. The cheaper model that carried the schema had failed 10 of 10 child sessions with no vendor recorded.

prerequisites: An Upstash Redis REST endpoint (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL + UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, or the KV_REST_API_* pair injected by the Vercel integration)
A Nebius Token Factory API key (NEBIUS_API_KEY) and a Tavily key (TAVILY_API_KEY)
A declared subagent whose tool surface you control — see recipe 02
A brief in evals/data/briefs.json to drive an end-to-end run

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Create .env.local with NEBIUS_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY and the Upstash REST pair (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN). Without the store, record_vendor returns not_configured and the run degrades to closing reports.

endpoints.description: One agent tree — the planner, every specialist, their recorded event logs, and the live per-category count of vendors written to the research store.
